name: What is a backyard guest house and what are its common uses?

mainEntity.name: What is a backyard guest house and what are its common uses?

acceptedAnswer.text: A backyard guest house, often called an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or granny flat, is a secondary residential structure on the same property as a primary home. They typically include a living area, kitchen, and bathroom. Common uses include housing for family members, a dedicated home office, a rental unit for additional income, or a private space for visitors. ADUs offer flexibility and can significantly enhance property value and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: A backyard guest house (ADU) is a secondary residence on your property, used for family, offices, rentals, or guests, adding value and flexibility.
